- `AC-201-01` — The contract names the team and bundle identifiers, development and release signing expectations, standard-versus-optional extension boundary, MCP bundle location and invocation, enforceable Agent Access state semantics and default, evidence time tiers and pressure behavior, export ownership, dashboard hierarchy, state matrix, accessibility behavior, and release ownership.
